title: kb-setup asks the deployment scope (me, team or org) and sets the clone's remotes by it, with a fetch-only upstream every push to which is refused
goal: kb-setup asks the operator for the clone's deployment scope (me, team or org) and records it in the clone's git config kb.scope; by the scope it names the upstream remote git config kb.upstreamRemote holds (the public GitHub copy for me and org, the public copy or the org's remote for team) with its push url disabled; the pre-push hook refuses a push of any ref to the upstream remote or its url, sync and publish refuse it as a target; git.md and maintaining.md hold the scope table and say the upstream is only fetched from

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if all(w in t for w in ('kb.scope','kb.upstreamRemote','me','team','org','fetch')) else 1)

import sys;g=open('kb/_self/git.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m=open('kb/_self/maintaining.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## Setup (first session in a fresh clone)')[1].split('\n## ')[0];sys.exit(0 if all('kb.upstreamRemote' in d and 'kb.scope' in d for d in (g,m)) else 1)

import subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]);subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'config','kb.scope','team']);sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as k;f=getattr(k,'clone_scope',None);sys.exit(0 if f and f(pathlib.Path(d))=='team' else 1)

clauses.clause: kb-setup asks the operator for the clone's deployment scope (me, team or org) and records it in the clone's git config kb.scope
by the scope it names the upstream remote git config kb.upstreamRemote holds (the public GitHub copy for me and org, the public copy or the org's remote for team) with its push url disabled
the pre-push hook refuses a push of any ref to the upstream remote or its url, sync and publish refuse it as a target
git.md and maintaining.md hold the scope table and say the upstream is only fetched from

notes: Premise (field report 2026-10-19): the deploy agent added an upstream remote from GitHub by hand on the Windows clone; nothing in kb-setup, kbpublic or the pre-push hook knows an upstream, so a push to it is guarded only when it is also kb.publishRemote. A production clone has no public home (git.md, Public home) and must never push to the public copy. Operator's answers 2026-10-19 in the planning session: scope table me = origin none or own fork, upstream GitHub, rebase local onto upstream; team = origin team GitLab, upstream GitHub or the org remote, merge upstream/main; org = origin org GitLab, upstream GitHub, merge upstream/main, and team clones fetch from it. The test ceiling profile is a separate setup question, not set by the scope. Check 3 reads the scope through kbpublic.clone_scope(path), the one reader every scope-aware tool (kbgit.py upstream, the backlog's provenance view) calls.
